entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The Zhalfirin captain of the skyship Weatherlight, immune to magic, descended from a family manipulated by Urza's bloodline project.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship that is a main part of Urza's Legacy; it is later granted sentience and sinks around Urborg after defeating Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: Urza's ultimate weapon against Phyrexia, a collection of artifacts including the Weatherlight and Karn.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who designed the bloodline project and the Legacy, and who later merges with Gerrard and Karn to complete the Legacy.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Sisay's descendant, who inherited immunity to magic.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The leader of the Phyrexians, who personally invades Dominaria as a Black Cloud of Death and is defeated by the completed Legacy.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who raided Sisay's village and later invaded Dominaria.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The place where Sisay's village stood and where she was captured by slavers.

entities.name: Suq'Atan slavers
entities.description: Slavers who captured the young Sisay.

entities.name: Burning Vengeance
entities.description: A pirate ship whose crew rescued Sisay.

entities.name: Murad
entities.description: Captain of the Burning Vengeance who trained Sisay.

entities.name: Mirage Wars
entities.description: A conflict during which Sisay became a minor celebrity by spying from her flying ship.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A young minotaur who defended Sisay, joined her crew and became first mate.

entities.name: Meida
entities.description: Sisay's first mate, killed in the fight in the Adarkar Wastes.

entities.name: Juju Bubble
entities.description: A piece of the Legacy recovered in the Adarkar Wastes.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose dreams compelled Sisay and her crew to rendezvous with Asmira and Rashida Scalebane.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: A man who brought peace to the region before and was freed by the crew.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: The true heir to the Legacy, who joins the Weatherlight crew and later merges with Urza and Karn.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: A Rathi fugitive and servant of the Phyrexians who betrayed Sisay and captured her and the Legacy.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The evincar of Rath and compleated form of Gerrard's step-brother Vuel, from whom Weatherlight retook the Legacy.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane where Sisay was held and freed.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The plane where Weatherlight crashed and where Sisay led a revolution.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria during which Sisay captained Weatherlight in many battles.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who is part of both the Weatherlight crew and the Legacy, and who later becomes a planeswalker.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: The Weatherlight's healer, taken back to Mercadia by Karn to marry Cho-Manno.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: One of the only remaining members of Sisay's former crew.

entities.name: Victory
entities.description: The new vessel given to Sisay by Dominarian leaders.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The area whose seas the Weatherlight sinks into.

events.summary: Phyrexians raid Sisay's village, orphaning her.
events.quote: Sisay was orphaned at a young age when they raided her village.

events.summary: Sisay sets out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it can kill the Lord of the Wastes, Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Sisay set out to gather the Legacy.

events.summary: Captured by Suq'Atan slavers, Sisay is rescued by the crew of the Burning Vengeance, burns her captor to death and joins the crew, training under Murad.
events.quote: She trained under Captain Murad until she became a full-fledged sailor

events.summary: Sisay becomes a minor celebrity during the Mirage Wars, spying on enemy positions for the Zhalfirin armies.
events.quote: She became a minor celebrity during the Mirage Wars

events.summary: A volcanic dragon forces her ship to land near the Talruum Mountains, where Tahngarth fights as her champion and joins her crew.
events.quote: He joined her crew and quickly proved himself.

events.summary: The crew recovers the Juju Bubble in the Adarkar Wastes; Meida is killed and Tahngarth becomes first mate.
events.quote: Tahngarth later took her place as first mate.

events.summary: Sisay's crew joins Asmira and Rashida Scalebane to free Mangara.
Sisay meets Gerrard and others influenced by the bloodline project, who join the Weatherlight crew.
events.quote: Among them Gerrard , the true heir to the Legacy.

events.summary: Starke, a servant of the Phyrexians, betrays Sisay and captures her and the Legacy.
events.quote: Sisay happily gathered them, only to be betrayed.

events.summary: Gerrard leads Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath.
events.quote: where they freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath

events.summary: Weatherlight crashes on Mercadia, where Sisay gathers artifacts to repair the ship and leads the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.
events.quote: she led the oppressed peoples of the plane to a successful shift in regime

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion begins and Sisay helms Weatherlight in many battles until it crashes when the Primeval Dragons attack.
events.quote: Sisay stood at the helm of Weatherlight during many battles against the Phyrexian fleets

events.summary: Karn uses the Thran Tome to integrate the Legacy into Weatherlight, rebuilding it and granting it sentience.
Gerrard, Urza and Karn merge to complete the Legacy, defeating Yawgmoth; Weatherlight sinks near Urborg, leaving Sisay without a ship.
events.quote: leaving Sisay adrift without a ship to captain

events.summary: A year after the Invasion, Karn takes Orim back to Mercadia, and Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee receive a new vessel named Victory.

relations.quote: a trait she passed on to her descendant, Shanna
Captain Sisay (siss-say ) was the Zhalfirin captain of the skyship Weatherlight

relations.note: Betrayed her on behalf of the Phyrexians.
relations.quote: Starke had been a servant of the Phyrexians and had been sent to capture Sisay and the Legacy.

relations.note: Compleated form of Gerrard's step-brother Vuel.
relations.quote: the compleated form of Gerrard's step-brother Vuel

relations.note: Joined her crew and became first mate.
relations.quote: He joined her crew and quickly proved himself.

relations.note: Led Weatherlight to Rath to free her.
relations.quote: could not ignore his friends in their time of need either
